title: Zugwise: Domain-Aware Game Reconstruction for Digitizing Handwritten Chess Scoresheets
description:
arXiv:2611.14544v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Digitizing handwritten chess scoresheets has been studied as a handwriting-recognition problem: read the move in each box and check that it is legal. This framing misses the errors that matter most. A misread that yields an illegal move is loud. One that yields a legal-but-wrong move is silent, because a legality-only pipeline accepts it and reads every later move against a wrong position.
